craft_maker.text: Kilkenny is a craft town. Kilkenny Design Workshops started in 1963, in the castle's old stables, to help Irish makers.
See the black tray? It is Kilkenny limestone, polished until it shines. Look closely for little fossils.
The fossils are shells and corals from a warm sea over 300 million years ago, when Ireland sat near the equator.
